$comment: The data flows between Jamie's systems: every hop content takes, who owns each field, and what watches each hop today. This file is the contract; shared/flows.html is rendered from it by `node shared/build-flows.mjs`. A hop is a row here before it is code anywhere. Times are America/Chicago unless a cron says otherwise.

kinds.thing: an entry in Things I've built
kinds.audio: an issue's audio edition or an episode's MP3
kinds.category: a blog post's categories, and a category's description
kinds.note: the note on a saved link

systems.name: Pinboard
systems.fact: posts/update gives the time of the last change (token needed).
systems.notes: Jamie's capture tool for links. No webhooks.

systems.name: micro.blog
systems.fact: The blog's feed shows the newest post; Micropub q=source shows a post's stored source. The rendered page can lag a Micropub write until micro.blog rebuilds.
systems.notes: Source of authority for the blog. Three writers: Jamie, WT Builder's mirror, the Library Agent.

systems.name: Tinylytics
systems.fact: Site and page view counts over its API (key needed).

systems.name: WT Builder
systems.fact: get_status (MCP) shows each issue's send legs; list_events shows what was sent when.
systems.notes: Authors and publishes each issue, and makes Another Thing since 2026-10-11 (that send has not run yet).

systems.name: Library Agent
systems.fact: Its run report under tmp/blog-round/<day>.md, and the blog_round events in the library.
systems.notes: Codex automation, daily 05:00. Runs the library round on the Mac (the one runner with the Tinylytics key), then files categories, fills alt and proposes Featured.

systems.name: Otto (OpenClaw)
systems.fact: openclaw cron list; state files under ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/.
systems.notes: Scheduled monitors that post to Discord, and the pinboard-enrichment skill that writes agent notes to Pinboard.

systems.name: Weekly Thing (web)
systems.fact: feed.xml and /archive/ show the newest issue; apps/site/archive/<n>.md on main is the issue's source.
systems.notes: Render surface. Source of authority for issues once sent.

systems.name: Buttondown
systems.fact: The newest email in the account.
systems.notes: The email edition. WT Builder makes a draft; Jamie sends it.

systems.name: files.thingelstad.com
systems.fact: An object exists at the URL the issue or episode names.

systems.name: Another Thing
systems.notes: Podcast publish surface. Episodes so far were committed by hand.

systems.name: Linking Things
systems.fact: /links.json and /issues.json; links_stats (MCP) gives last_saved and latest_issue; data/sync.json holds Pinboard's stamp and the fetch time.
systems.notes: Every public link since 2005, built from a nightly commit.

systems.name: Things I've built
systems.fact: The registry on the site; activity.xml carries each day's collected observations.
systems.notes: Content changes by pull request; a daily collector refreshes observations.

systems.name: Librarian
systems.fact: Each corpus object in S3 carries its fact as metadata (newest-id, newest-at, item-count, built-at; since 2026-10-26): a HEAD says the newest item of each kind the uploaded corpus holds. latest_content and corpus_stats (MCP) show the same from the deployed corpus; library.db in S3 holds what the library pulled.
systems.notes: The library (library.db in S3), the five corpora, and the API Thingy and MCP clients answer from.

systems.name: Thingy
systems.fact: librarian.thingelstad.com/health reports source_revision and corpus_versions, the S3 versions of the corpus objects the running build was deployed against (since 2026-10-26): where they match the objects' current versions, Thingy serves what the Librarian holds; where one differs, the redeploy that serves the newer upload has not landed.
systems.notes: Chat client of the Librarian API. MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) read the same corpus through librarian.thingelstad.com/mcp.

systems.name: cards.thingelstad.com
systems.fact: A card URL returns an image drawn from the post as it is now.
systems.notes: Draws each post's social card from its h-entry on request; CloudFront caches it.

hops.moves: Every bookmark saved inside the issue's window.
hops.mechanism: Pinboard API read on open and on sweep.
hops.verify: The link is an item in the issue (get_item).

hops.moves: Jamie's commentary edits, mirrored back as his note.
hops.mechanism: Compare-and-set write-back; a bookmark changed at Pinboard since the last scan is marked conflict, not written.
hops.verify: The bookmark's note at Pinboard matches the item.

hops.moves: Posts in the window, for the Journal; later edits to posts not edited in WT Builder.
hops.mechanism: Micropub q=source read on open; reconcile adopts micro.blog edits, conflict only when both sides edited.
hops.verify: The post is a Journal item with the current text.

hops.moves: Edits to a Journal item, and the Weekly Thing category on reprinted posts.
hops.mechanism: Micropub update, compare-and-set.
hops.verify: q=source for the post shows the edit.

hops.moves: Every public bookmark, as the year shards under data/links/.
hops.mechanism: tools/nightly.sh: sync.py (posts/update, then posts/all if the stamp moved), join, enrichment, validate, commit, push; the push deploys.
hops.verify: links_stats last_saved is after the bookmark's save time; data/sync.json updated matches Pinboard's posts/update.
hops.notes: The run took about three hours on 2026-10-26 (Wayback lookups). A link saved at 01:00 waits until the next night's run, then the run time: about 28 hours at worst.

hops.moves: Which issue carried each link (the /issues/<n>/ pages and wt: search).
hops.mechanism: join_issues.py reads the issue pages' front matter from the sibling checkout ../thingelstad.com/weekly.thingelstad.com/apps/site/archive on the Mac, inside the nightly run.
hops.verify: links_stats latest_issue equals the newest issue on weekly.thingelstad.com.
hops.notes: Broken on 2026-10-26: WT354 was sent 2026-10-24, the nightly ran green, and Linking Things still reports 353. The sibling checkout was on a feature branch without 354.md. Fix: read weekly's published archive over HTTPS, or origin main, never a working checkout; and nudge the join from the send (hop 10).

hops.moves: The issue's generated 11ty inputs (apps/site/archive/<n>.md and its assets).
hops.mechanism: The website leg commits to main; the deploy workflow builds and publishes on push.
hops.verify: feed.xml carries the issue; /archive/<n>/ renders.
hops.notes: Sent for every issue since WT350.

hops.moves: The email edition, as a draft.
hops.mechanism: Buttondown API: creates and updates a draft. Never schedules, never sends; Jamie sends.
hops.verify: The draft exists with the issue's subject; the email goes out when Jamie sends it.

hops.moves: The issue's audio edition (with chapters and VTT) and every rehosted image.
hops.mechanism: Upload to files.thingelstad.com before the website and email legs; content-named files, so a re-render re-sends the website leg.
hops.verify: The URL the issue names returns the object.

hops.moves: The news that an issue is out (its number), not the text.
hops.mechanism: repository_dispatch issue-sent to librarian-thing after the website leg; the library round pulls the issue page from weekly.thingelstad.com and ends the weekend hold.
hops.verify: The round's 'The sent issue arrived' step passed; latest_content lists the issue.
hops.notes: Sent for every issue since WT350. Linking Things gets no such nudge (hop 6).

hops.moves: Every post and page, with categories and alt as micro.blog holds them.
hops.mechanism: library.py round --only blog, on the Mac (Library Agent, 05:00) and on GitHub (07:17) as the backstop. The round declares a blog-published dispatch, but nothing sends it.
hops.verify: latest_content source_kind blog lists the post; the library's blog fingerprint moved.
hops.notes: Two runners for one round means two answers to 'when did it last run'. blog-published, podcast-published and things-published are declared in library-round.yml and sent by no one (checked 2026-10-26).

hops.moves: Each episode and its transcript, into the podcast corpus.
hops.mechanism: library.py round --only another, from the published site. podcast-published is declared but never sent.
hops.verify: latest_content source_kind podcast lists the episode.

hops.moves: The registry of things, into the reference base.
hops.mechanism: library.py round --only things, from the published site. things-published is declared but never sent.
hops.verify: get_source thing-<id> returns the current page.

hops.moves: Every public link, one passage each, into the links corpus.
hops.mechanism: library.py round --only links reads Linking Things' published JSON (its nightly snapshot).
hops.verify: latest_content source_kind link lists the link.
hops.notes: Stacks on hop 5: a link saved at 01:00 reaches the Librarian the morning after next, about 52 hours at worst.

hops.moves: View counts per post, page and issue.
hops.mechanism: library.py round --only readers, Mac only (the GitHub round has no Tinylytics key).
hops.verify: The library's readers table has yesterday's counts.

hops.moves: The embedded corpora the API answers from (Weekly Thing, blog, podcast, reference, links).
hops.mechanism: deploy.yml rebuilds each corpus the library moved past, uploads to S3, redeploys the Lambda; Thingy and MCP clients answer from it at once.

trigger.event: a round that moved the library, or a push to the pipeline

hops.verify: latest_content and corpus_stats show the item.
hops.hold: From Friday 00:00 until the send (Friday and Saturday, US Central) no automatic build changes the corpus; the round still updates the library. Read 'held', not 'stale'.
hops.notes: Thingy's drift check (06:17 daily) compares its vendored contract with the Librarian's main and files a GitHub issue on drift.

hops.moves: The topic graph (graph.json) that renders the topic pages.
hops.mechanism: deploy.yml commits data/librarian/graph.json to weekly.thingelstad.com with a PAT; the push deploys.

trigger.event: a corpus build that changed the graph

hops.verify: weekly's topic pages list the new issue.

hops.moves: Retrieval for Thingy drafts, Echoes and the earlier issues that carried a link.
hops.mechanism: The versioned /retrieve contract, read live.
hops.verify: get_item shows the earlier issues that carried the link.

hops.moves: Categories for unfiled posts, alt for photos without it, and the Featured choice (proposed to Jamie first).
hops.mechanism: make blog-round --write: Micropub update by URL, id-checked (q=source, trust only uid, write, read back). Guards: fill blanks only, 50 category and 20 alt writes a day, never an turned into markdown, WRITES_ON flag.
hops.verify: q=source shows the edit, and the rendered page shows it after micro.blog rebuilds.
hops.notes: First write round, 2026-10-22: 20 edits accepted by Micropub, 4 missing from the rendered pages after the rebuild. The read-back checks Micropub, not the page, so the round was green. A write needs a receipt: written, rendered, pulled back (hop 11).

hops.moves: The post's title, date, categories and text, for its social card.
hops.mechanism: The card Lambda reads the post's h-entry on request; CloudFront caches the image. A drawing change needs /www/* invalidated.
hops.verify: The card URL draws the post as it is now.

hops.moves: An episode: outline, mastered audio, transcript, one commit.
hops.mechanism: The Another Thing send (/another), built 2026-10-11. It commits the episode, its transcript and the MP3 to git; since 2026-10-26 the MP3's home is the another-site audio bucket, served by CloudFront at the same /uploads/ URL.
hops.verify: podcast.xml carries the episode.
hops.notes: Never run. Episodes so far were committed by hand. Needs ANOTHER_GITHUB_PAT_TOKEN. Before the DNS cutover retires Pages, the send must put the MP3 in the audio bucket and write audioBytes and audioSeconds instead of committing it; until then the deploy-aws job refuses a feed whose MP3 is not in the bucket (npm run audio:put fixes it).

hops.moves: An agent-written summary on a link in the reading queue, tagged _agent.
hops.mechanism: The OpenClaw pinboard-enrichment skill, writing through the Pinboard API.

trigger.schedule: unknown (no cron job carries the name today)

hops.verify: The note carries the _agent tag; Linking Things shows the voice as agent.
hops.notes: 68 agent-voice notes exist on Linking Things. No OpenClaw cron job carries this name on 2026-10-26; whether it still runs is unconfirmed.

fields.others_may: WT Builder reprints a post in the Journal and mirrors Jamie's edits back (hop 4).
fields.never: The Library Agent edits a post's words.

fields.others_may: Jamie edits freely in micro.blog; WT Builder sets the Weekly Thing category on reprinted posts.
fields.never: The Library Agent overwrites a category a person chose. It files unfiled posts and proposes changes in its report. Descriptions are micro.blog's Intro field, set by hand.
The Library Agent changes alt that is already there, or turns an into markdown.

fields.others_may: Jamie decides on the first list before anything is written.
fields.never: A Featured write without Jamie having seen the list.

fields.others_may: The Librarian copies it and adapts the copy for the corpus; weekly.thingelstad.com renders it and is the source of authority once sent.
WT Builder mirrors Jamie's commentary back (hop 2); Otto adds agent-voice summaries tagged _agent (hop 22); Linking Things and the Librarian read.
fields.never: A note rewritten by a system without the _agent tag.

fields.others_may: Nothing. WT Builder neither selects on it nor writes it.

fields.never: A topic edited on the site.

fields.others_may: another.thingelstad.com publishes it; the Librarian imports the transcript (hop 12).
fields.never: A hand edit on the site once the send runs (today, every episode was a hand commit; see hop 21).

watchers.name: weekly-thing-feed-publication-monitor
watchers.where: OpenClaw cron on the Mac, 12:00 daily, posts to Discord
watchers.sees: A new item in weekly's feed.xml or podcast.xml.

watchers.name: another-thing-podcast-feed-monitor
watchers.where: OpenClaw cron on the Mac, 08:15 daily, posts to Discord

watchers.name: weekly-automation-health-check
watchers.where: OpenClaw cron on the Mac, Mondays 08:30, posts to Discord only on failure
watchers.sees: Failed, disabled or stale OpenClaw jobs.
watchers.misses: Jobs outside OpenClaw: launchd, GitHub Actions, Codex automations.

watchers.name: Thingy drift check
watchers.where: GitHub Actions in thingy.thingelstad.com, 06:17 daily, files or closes a GitHub issue
watchers.sees: The vendored Librarian contract and MCP surface drifting from librarian-thing main; npm advisories.

watchers.name: CloudWatch alarms (Thingy, Librarian API, Linking Things MCP)
watchers.where: AWS, into the projects-ops-alerts queue the Operator drains at 06:30
watchers.sees: 5xx rates, auth bursts, throttling, dead letters, the subscribe path.
watchers.misses: Whether the data is current. No alarm anywhere measures lag.

watchers.name: Library round run status
watchers.sees: A red run, including a blog pull skipped for a missing key.
watchers.misses: Nobody is notified of a red scheduled run.

watchers.name: nightly.log
watchers.misses: A green run that joined a stale checkout (hop 6, 2026-10-26).
